slides.title: In One Sentence
slides.big: Core inflation measures price changes excluding food and energy.
slides.body: Food and energy prices jump around a lot, so removing them can reveal the underlying trend.
slides.source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics

slides.title: How It Works
items: Start with all the prices in the CPI basket.
Take out food and energy items.
Track what is left month to month.
slides.footer: Headline CPI keeps food and energy in.
slides.disclaimer: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.

slides.title: Why It Matters to You
slides.body: Core is not a cost-of-living gauge. Groceries and gas are real costs, but core helps show where prices may head.

slides.title: Remember This
items: Core leaves out food and energy.
Headline shows all prices, core shows the trend.
